caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile with visible fringes along each side, placed on a light-colored background. The textile features a central image of a person riding a horse; the horse is brown with black detailing on its mane, tail, and legs, and is shown in a dynamic running or jumping pose. The rider is dressed in a blue outfit with a red cap and red accents, and one arm is extended forward holding a light-colored object. Below the horse, there is a blue and turquoise pattern resembling water or ground. Around the central image, there is a wide border with a repeated floral or star motif in red on a beige background. In the bottom left corner, outside the textile, the name "ELMER WEISL" is printed in small black letters. The entire textile is set against an off-white or pale tan surface.
title: Cross-Stitch Antimacassar
